verdict.rationale: Cactus documents that the paid platform can be driven from the dashboard, CLI, Python, or a coding agent with an API key. A published OpenAPI spec covers the core platform workflow: generating training data, fine-tuning Needle 3, and downloading models. API endpoints are documented for data generation, tool schemas, uploads, training depth, and billing, which suggests broad but unconfirmed parity. The probe's 404s at root OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented /v1/openapi.json. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that every dashboard action has an API equivalent, a documented UI-versus-API feature mapping, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Platform (Starter, Pro, Custom): The dashboard, CLI, Python, or a coding agent with your API key.
Generate tool-calling training data, fine-tune Needle 3, and download the resulting models.
GET /billing returns your plan, its limits and what this period has used.
